Consent Details [#IABV2SETTINGS#] About This website uses cookies We use cookies to personalise content and ads, to provide social media features and to analyse our traffic. We also share information about your use of our site with our social media, advertising and analytics partners who may combine it with other information that you’ve provided to them or that they’ve collected from your use of their services. You consent to our cookies if you continue to use our website. About SkinVision SkinVision was founded with a mission to improve access to skin health information and support individuals in becoming more aware of their skin over time. Headquartered in Europe, SkinVision collaborates with medical experts, researchers, and institutions to advance its work in digital health. The company is committed to responsible innovation and to meeting regulatory requirements in every market it serves. Our Approach We believe that increasing awareness and accessibility in skin health can play an important role in helping people take a more active role in their health journey. Our work is guided by a focus on accessibility and ease of use, collaboration with clinical and academic partners, and a commitment to regulatory standards and patient safety. SkinVision collaborates with leading institutions to support ongoing research and development in digital health.
